notes.title: Thank you for 10k downloads + (free) fan pack release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been about two weeks since the launch of 'memories' and in that time we crossed 10k downloads!!!💟🎉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210387/8ad6c01020b4f243f9783d18163e0fb24685dd68.png

Thank you all so so much for your love and support. As a game developer, I've always strived to make games that emotionally move people in ways that are personal to them, and I'm so happy that I was able to reach so many of your hearts through a little game called 'memories'.

As a thank-you for 10k downloads, I've spent the past few days compiling a special fan pack for the game.

You can download the fanpack at this link:
https://ko-fi.com/s/9a6cd0b5f7

The pack is completely free ✨, and contains:
- 11 unique wallpapers (10 from the game, 1 bonus)
- 3 special artworks
- 1 thank you note from the developer (me!)


Thank you again so much for your love and support. I hope I can continue to make games that you will all love in the future! 💞

As always, feel free to follow me on Twitter to receive updates about my future game development ventures.

Thank you and love you all!

- 💛 guiyyu

notes.title: Thank you for 2.5k downloads (+ update patch notes)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, my name is guiyyu and I'm the developer of 'memories'.
We've just crossed 2.5k downloads! Thank you so much for all your love and support for the game.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1071008597141622814/1072821150998077470/memories_2.5k.png?width=603&height=675

Now for some other announcements...

Fixed Bugs/Additions
- Added volume settings: You can now adjust the sound and music volume in the options menu.
- Reworked ending: The ending of the game has been reworked for greater clarity.

Feel free to follow me on my social media if you'd like to support me and future games I create.
Thank you again everyone :)

- guiyyu
